messages:
marco_sales: Quick sync on CopperGate POC: customer requires BYO-KMS for regulated PII. Must support customer-held KEK in HSM, monthly rotations, dual-custody, and an attestation package for compliance. They also asked for HSM egress vs platform-key pricing delta. Who can own the POC?

anya_se: I can lead. Need their HSM endpoints (IPs/ports), FIPS level, and whether dual-custody means threshold-split keys or two distinct KEK holders. Also confirm if they want signed vendor attestations or raw manifests.

lina_eng: Note latency impact if we call HSM on hot path: ~40-70ms p99. Options: local key-proxy with short-lived wrapped tokens (adds infra + audit surface) or only touch HSM at rotation and use platform KEK for token ops. Need expected QPS to model costs.

david_security: From GRC: require HSM vendor + FIPS level, attestation format, rotation proof, audit retention (we default 90d), and absolute no-export guarantee in writing. Also require opt-in for fallback KEK in SOW.

marco_sales: Pricing structure suggestion: one-time SOW for onboarding/attestation + either (A) hosted per-request HSM egress fees or (B) include in Dedicated reserved fee if they buy commitment. I'll prepare delta table.

ops_bot: Ticket created: POC-1722 "CopperGate BYO-KMS POC - network & attestation" assigned @anya_se. ETA draft runbook 2025-04-02. https://redwood.example.com/t/POC-1722

anya_se: Proposed minimal acceptance tests: 1) wrap/unwrap using customer KEK alias; 2) verify audit entries on both sides; 3) simulate rotation and test fallback to platform KEK for 30min; 4) measure latency with/without proxy.

lina_eng: SLA note: for enterprise SOW we can offer 4hr response for rotation incidents and automatic fallback behavior if customer signs opt-in. Operational cost will vary by QPS and chosen architecture.

marco_sales: I'll request IPs, attestation spec, QPS, and legal sign-off on fallback. Will loop back after customer reply. Thanks :thumbsup:
